scope: strict final ROI + full-frame actor filter + Turhancan candidates + frozen YOLO26s crop head + bounded deferred recovery

temporal_high_semantic_provisional_visua.note: Architecture review of event cards, not a user-blinded ground-truth round.

findings: The user-drawn strict ROI and actor filter remove the broad-ROI road/vehicle failure mode in the tested 01027 window.
Deferred temporal recovery restores the known visible white paper that the frozen head can reject.
Temporal persistence also restores stable non-litter objects; repetition is not sufficient semantic evidence.
The frozen head passes a median 20 candidates per tick in the 01022 ROI and therefore cannot be connected as an immediate display/alert gate.
The current chain is a useful high-recall proposal and data-mining pipeline, but is not a production detector.

next_experiment.name: context-aware candidate classifier screening
next_experiment.goal: Replace the frozen linear crop head with a transfer-learned crop+context classifier, then rerun the same frozen event replay.
next_experiment.stop_rule: Stop this classifier route if an untouched date cannot reach visible-litter recall >= 0.90 and weighted negative reduction >= 0.80, or if 5-minute event replay exceeds 2 false events/hour after temporal confirmation.
